# Rebinder

> Rebinder is an open-source Rust CLI for cross-harness session continuity between coding agents.

Two-way transfer is operational for local Claude Code and Codex sessions. `rebinder sessions claude|codex` lists source IDs and recorded workspaces; `rebinder transfer --from claude --to codex` and `rebinder transfer --from codex --to claude` open an interactive selector when the ID is omitted. `rebinder continuity enable claude --to codex` installs an optional personal Claude plugin that observes documented five-hour and seven-day subscriber windows, asks once per provider reset window, and arms a handoff only after explicit consent. A documented Claude `StopFailure(rate_limit)` event creates a deduplicated out-of-band rescue; after Claude exits, the Rebinder parent or `rebinder continuity rescue` asks locally before any target starts. A source opened with `rebinder claude` exits before the waiting parent prepares and opens Codex; direct Claude launches use the printed `rebinder continuity resume` or rescue fallback. Claude-to-Codex uses native import for small sources and a bounded, role-preserving handoff for larger ones. Codex-to-Claude reads through Codex's app-server, creates a private canonical checkpoint, and starts or resumes a deterministic native Claude session through supported CLI arguments. Both directions create a visible continuation brief on a new semantic revision and avoid duplicate injection on an unchanged repeat. Missing workspaces fail closed by default; explicit `--recover-worktree` recreates only an exact unlocked entry that a local Git repository still registers, verifies its committed checkout, and never clones, fetches, overwrites, unlocks, or restores uncommitted state. `rebinder export --from claude|codex` creates a private, self-validated canonical package without resuming or modifying the provider session; private reasoning, tool payloads, attachments, environment values, remote URLs, and tool payloads are excluded. `rebinder capabilities` declares preserved, summarized, and omitted target state; `rebinder compatibility` reports package-specific loss; and `rebinder artifact` creates bounded provider-neutral Markdown from a validated package. The portable package validator and native command facades remain available independently.

## Product

- [Project README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bahadirarda/rebinder/main/README.md): Installation, CLI usage, current boundaries, release identity, and development commands.
- [Product requirements](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bahadirarda/rebinder/main/docs/product/product-requirements.md): Product behavior, user model, requirements, and constraints.
- [MVP status](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bahadirarda/rebinder/main/docs/product/mvp-status.md): Operational two-way transfer, portability, and registered-worktree recovery boundaries.
- [Terminology](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bahadirarda/rebinder/main/docs/terminology.md): Canonical project language.

## Architecture and format

- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bahadirarda/rebinder/main/docs/architecture/architecture.md): Component boundaries and the intended transfer pipeline.
- [Interchange Format 0.1.0](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bahadirarda/rebinder/main/docs/format/interchange-format-0.1.md): Canonical portable session package and validation rules.
- [CLI command model](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bahadirarda/rebinder/main/docs/decisions/ADR-0003-cli-command-model.md): Provider-native passthrough and explicit transfer syntax.
- [Codex native transfer bridge](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bahadirarda/rebinder/main/docs/decisions/ADR-0005-codex-native-import-bridge.md): One-way native API architecture, selection rules, and failure boundaries.
- [Capability-aware continuation artifacts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bahadirarda/rebinder/main/docs/decisions/ADR-0006-capability-aware-continuation-artifacts.md): Target declarations, package-specific loss reporting, and bounded artifact rules.
- [Non-resuming canonical provider export](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bahadirarda/rebinder/main/docs/decisions/ADR-0007-non-resuming-canonical-export.md): Claude and Codex read surfaces, redaction boundary, and private self-validated package output.
- [Canonical Codex-to-Claude continuation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bahadirarda/rebinder/main/docs/decisions/ADR-0008-canonical-codex-to-claude-continuation.md): Deterministic native Claude binding, semantic revision reuse, and private bounded context injection.
- [Opt-in registered worktree recovery](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bahadirarda/rebinder/main/docs/decisions/ADR-0009-opt-in-registered-worktree-recovery.md): Exact-path Git registry proof, no-overwrite rules, and post-checkout verification.
- [Consent-gated proactive handoff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bahadirarda/rebinder/main/docs/decisions/ADR-0010-consent-gated-proactive-handoff.md): Authoritative usage signals, one-window offers, explicit consent, and post-exit target launch.
- [Authoritative hard-limit rescue](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bahadirarda/rebinder/main/docs/decisions/ADR-0011-authoritative-hard-limit-rescue.md): Typed provider failure signal, deduplicated out-of-band rescue, local consent, and no nested target process.

## Distribution

- [Verified shell installer](https://bahadirarda.github.io/rebinder/install.sh): Checksum-verifying native installer for Linux and macOS.
- [Verified PowerShell installer](https://bahadirarda.github.io/rebinder/install.ps1): Checksum-verifying native installer for Windows x86-64.
- [Release system](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bahadirarda/rebinder/main/docs/governance/release-system.md): Calendar versions, protected release automation, checksums, and attestations.
- [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/bahadirarda/rebinder/releases): Native binaries, installers, checksums, metadata, and attestations.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/bahadirarda/rebinder): Rust source, schemas, examples, documentation, and delivery workflows.
